summary: Wave-dependent duelist who dashes through minions with Q resets and wins extended fights at full passive stacks. She's strongest when there are low-HP minions to dash on and weakest when you deny her stacks or land CC on her before she stuns you.
threats: Q (Bladesurge) resets on kills or on marked targets, so a low-HP wave is her highway to you.
Passive (Ionian Fervor): at max stacks she gains big attack speed and bonus on-hit damage. Don't fight her at 4+ stacks.
E (Flawless Duet) stuns along the line between her two blades and marks you for a Q reset.
R (Vanguard's Edge) at 5 marks everyone it hits and leaves a blade wall that slows you if you walk through it.

matchups.why: Irelia's damage is mostly physical autos and on-hit, which Malphite's armor and E (Ground Slam) attack-speed slow cut down hard. His targeted Q poke chips her every time she dashes into the wave, and she can't kill him through stacked armor.
trading: Q (Seismic Shard) her as she dashes onto a minion near you; the speed steal makes her follow-up dash harder.
The moment she's in melee range, E (Ground Slam) to slow her attack speed before her passive stacks up.
Keep Granite Shield up before she engages; don't let minion aggro pop it.
Walk sideways out of her E line rather than backwards. The stun only hits along the line between the blades.
matchups.early: Farm safely and Q poke. She'll try to dash in with stacks; slow her attacks with E and let your armor do the work.
matchups.spike: At 5, your R lets your jungler kill her through her dashes. Her R slows you, so don't chase through the blade wall.
matchups.wave: Keep the wave near your tower and avoid letting it get low near you; low-HP minions give her free Q resets.
matchups.jungle: She escapes by dashing on minions. Ping your jungler when she's dashed in and the nearby minions are healthy.
matchups.build: Grasp of the Undying. Plated Steelcaps and early armor (Bramble Vest).
matchups.remember: Armor up, slow her attacks, deny her dash targets.

matchups.why: Counter Strike dodges Irelia's autos, which is most of her damage, and stuns her if she stays in. Jax trades well whenever she dashes in, and his R resists blunt her on-hit damage later.
trading: Hold E (Counter Strike) until she dashes onto you, then activate it to dodge her autos and stun her.
Leap Strike (Q) onto her or a nearby minion to follow her if she dashes away.
Don't trade while Counter Strike is on cooldown and she has 4+ passive stacks.
Use W (Empower) to reset your auto timer and burst her during the stun.
matchups.early: Even at level 1, then favored once you have E. Trade when she dashes into you and your E is ready.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R gives armor/MR and on-hit damage, and you win extended fights. Her R slows you, so hold Q to cross it.
matchups.wave: Keep the wave healthy near you so she has no low minions to dash through.
matchups.jungle: She's gankable after she's used Q on you; call when she's stunned by your E.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Trinity Force-style bruiser items; armor boots.

matchups.why: Darius wins any fight he can start with E pull, but Irelia's dash through minions can avoid his E, and her E stun interrupts his combo. The lane comes down to whether you land E before she lands her stun.
trading: E (Apprehend) pull her as soon as she dashes onto a minion within range.
Stack Hemorrhage with W and autos while she's stuck in melee range.
Walk sideways out of her E line rather than backwards.
Hit her with the outer edge of Q as she dashes away for damage and healing.
matchups.early: Even. Trade when she dashes in and your E is ready; don't chase her through her wave.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R resets on kill, but her R slows you. Track her R before committing.
matchups.wave: Freeze near your tower so she has to dash through your E range.
matchups.jungle: She escapes with Q dashes on minions. Gank when the nearby minions are healthy.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Armor boots; anti-heal isn't needed.

matchups.why: Wind Wall can't block Irelia's melee damage, and she dashes through the same minions Yasuo uses. Her E stun interrupts his Q knockup setups, and she wins extended trades at max passive.
trading: Use E (Sweeping Blade) to dodge her Q dashes rather than trading back into a full passive.
Throw your Q3 tornado through her when she's lining up her E blades; the knockup cancels the stun setup.
Back off when she has 4+ passive stacks; that's when she wins every extended trade.
Trade only after she's used E. Without it she has no stun to stop your combo.
matchups.early: Farm safely and trade only when her E is on cooldown. Don't dash through the wave toward her.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R needs a knockup from your Q3 or a teammate; land it on her after she's spent E.
matchups.wave: Keep the wave near your tower; don't fight her through low-HP minions.
matchups.jungle: Ask for ganks; your Q3 knockup sets them up.
matchups.remember: Wait out her E, then knock her up.
